description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family**
Full-stack Engineer
  
  
**Role Type**
Full Time
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Risk and Compliance Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Risk Management, Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
  
  
We’re lookin
**g**
for a Full-stack Engineer (front-end focussed) at EY GDS. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, deploy, and manage scalable back-end services, APIs, and database integrations that meet business needs and leverage best practices in full-stack development and cloud technologies. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering. We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial and non-financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective.
  
  
EY Risk and Compliance Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Engineering (RCE) practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s RCE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Front-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript and Java-based technologies.
* API Integration: Work with REST APIs and GraphQL services for data integration.
* Back-End Development: Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.
* CI/CD Management: Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Technology Updates: Stay updated with emerging web technologies and apply best practices in performance and security.

**Required Skills:**

* 4+ years of experience in full-stack application development with strong expertise in React and Java technologies.

* Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design, and browser compatibility.
* Experience with state management libraries, component-driven architecture, reusable UI development, and front-end performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency in Core Java (Java 8+) and object-oriented programming principles.
* Hands-on experience with Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections Framework, Java Streams, and Functional Programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming using CompletableFuture, Executor Framework, and Thread Pools.
* Good knowledge of JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection, and performance tuning.
* Extensive experience in developing enterprise applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Data JPA.
* Experience in designing and developing Microservices-based architectures.
* Strong understanding of RESTful Web Services, API design standards, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience implementing application security using OAuth2, JWT, and role-based access controls.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Strong proficiency with Git and modern source control practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Domain: Prior experience in the Financial Services / FS Risk domain.
* Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
* Familiarity with AI/GenAI concepts, such as LLM fundamentals and prompt engineering. Ability to work with AI APIs or AI-powered components in application development.

**Education:**
**Degree:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions.

We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.

In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance & Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Demonstrates strong AI acumen, with the ability to effectively leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.
* AINS Certifications or other insurance industry certifications.
* CBAP (Certified Business Analyst Professional) or similar business analysis certification.
* Web Services/APIs and ACORD standards experience.
